lines.en: A low growl as it approaches.
Sharp claws ready to strike!
Raging eyes locked on you.

lines.zh: 饥饿的吼声响起，渴望鲜血。
lines.en: Ravenous growl, craving blood.
Gurgling sound, ready to devour.
Tusks exposed, sharp as a knife.
Closes in, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 我原地站着，目光先走了一步。
lines.en: I stand still; my gaze goes first.

lines.zh: 站在这里，等你自己靠近。
lines.en: I stand here and wait for you to come.
Low growl from the throat.

lines.zh: 我站定不动，等你入视野。
lines.en: I stand still, waiting for you to enter view.
Silent, waiting for an opening.
Patience, waiting for prey.
Silent, waiting for the right moment.
Silently waiting, ready to attack.
Observing patiently, looking for prey.
Quietly waiting, for one strike.
Patiently waiting, not in a rush.
Patiently waiting for prey.
Silently waiting, for the right moment.

lines.zh: 它站在原处，等你自投罗网。
lines.en: It stands still, waiting for you to come to it.

lines.zh: 脚钉在地上，眼睛却在走。
lines.en: Its feet are rooted, but its eyes travel.

lines.zh: 数着你的脚步，一动不动。
lines.en: Counting your steps without moving.

lines.zh: 剧情还没到，它只能站着。
lines.en: The story hasn't reached it, so it just stands.

lines.zh: 它等脚本把它放进这一幕。
lines.en: It waits for the script to place it in this scene.

lines.zh: 静止的身影，排练过的姿势。
lines.en: A still figure in a rehearsed pose.
Locks on to you.
Eyes turn to you.
Detected your scent.
I stand still and only watch.
Eyes turn to you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，等你走错一步。
lines.en: I stare, waiting for one wrong step.
Eyes locked on, ready to strike.
Detected you, preparing to pounce.
Focused on you, ready to ambush.

lines.zh: 我八刻确认完，眼睛钉住你。
lines.en: Eight ticks of confirmation; my eyes pin you.

lines.zh: 四十度的视线，正好套住你。
lines.en: A forty-degree cone lands right on you.

lines.zh: 八刻确认，它才相信你在这。
lines.en: Eight ticks of confirmation before it believes you're here.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，等你走进锥形。
lines.en: It stares, waiting for you to enter its cone.
Its gaze sweeps past like turning a page.

lines.zh: 它把你的位置记进下一幕。
lines.en: It writes your position into the next scene.
Injured heavily, Stalker wails
Severely injured, groans continuously
Injured, howls in pain
Injured, wails repeatedly
Injured, mourns bitterly
Injured, shrieks in pain
Injured, mourns with a howl
Injured, wails in agony
Severely injured, mourns loudly
Injured, cries in pain
You're getting too close, hunter.
Stay off my territory.
Food lingers around you.
I guard the treasure here.
Don't let greed deceive you.

lines.zh: 别拿食物试我，我的爪更快。
lines.en: Don't test me with food; my claws are quicker.

lines.zh: 脚本把我钉在这，走不了。
lines.en: The script nails me here; I can't move.
You came too close; the script has changed.

lines.zh: 我一步也动不了，全靠脚本。
lines.en: I can't move a step; the script does it.

lines.zh: 我盯了你八个刻度，够了。
lines.en: I watched you for eight ticks. That's enough.

lines.zh: 我一步也挪不开，只能用眼睛推你。
lines.en: I can't move a step; I push with my eyes.
I can't move — I can only watch you.

lines.zh: 你踏进来的每一步，我都数着。
lines.en: I count every step you take in here.
I won't let you go easily.

lines.zh: 我警告过你，现在尝尝后果。
lines.en: I warned you, now taste the consequences.
You've caused a commotion.
You've touched my borders.

lines.zh: 我动不了，可我一直在你身后。
lines.en: I can't move — yet I'm always behind you.
I won't spare you.
My patience is limited.
Find my mate, hunter.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能一直看你。
lines.en: I can't move. I can only watch you.

lines.zh: 这一幕里，我缺一个同伴。
lines.en: In this scene I lack a companion.
Survive together.
We share this land.

lines.zh: 我钉在原处，等地一个人来。
lines.en: I'm nailed here, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 这一场里，你愿意站我旁边吗？
lines.en: In this scene, will you stand beside me?
The script says we're paired from here.
I'm your only choice.

lines.zh: 我动不了，但这一场我护着你。
lines.en: I can't move, but I'll guard you in this scene.
Slurp! Drop that meat!
Hey, that’s my dinner!
My teeth are waiting for it!
You can't run, I'll catch you!
Flesh! I want it!
Tastes so good!
Finish this meal first!
This is a delicious meal!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，尝尝我的牙吧！
lines.en: You can't escape, feel my teeth!

lines.zh: 这东西落在我的领地里，归我。
lines.en: It fell on my ground; it's mine.
Got you, my prey!
Target locked!
Time for a meal!
In range, start moving!
Here I come, my prey!
Preparing to taste the prey!

lines.zh: 我站在原地，脚本让我盯住你。
lines.en: I stand still; the script points me at you.
My sight is on the target!

lines.zh: 你走进四十度里，我就锁定。
lines.en: Step into my forty degrees and I have you.
Waiting for the chance to get closer!
You stepped into its sight cone.
Confirmed. The tracking begins.
It has locked onto your name.
This scene needs you as the prey.
It stops merely standing and starts staring.
The script turns; you are chosen.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声进了它的记录。
lines.en: Your footsteps entered its record.
It has decided you must stay.
I'm going to feast on it!
My target, my prey!
Now is its end!
Keep your eyes on it!
It's for my dinner!
Don't try to escape, nowhere to go!
My teeth will take care of it!
Waiting for my command to attack!
Get closer, I'm going to eat it!
Taste its flavor!
Only the final moment of confirmation is left.
Its sight pins your chest.

lines.zh: 你退一步，它的锥形跟着。
lines.en: You step back; its cone follows.
It calculates when you will break.
A growl rehearses in its throat.
The climax of this scene is near.
It doesn't move, yet the pressure closes in.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经被它圈住。
lines.en: Your shadow is already circled.
Its breath lands on your neck.
It waits only for the script's cue.
Feast on my claws.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，视线锁着你。
lines.en: I stay put and keep my eyes on you.
No need to chase; one swipe is enough.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从原地扫到你面前。
lines.en: My claws sweep from where I stand to your face.
Die by my fangs.
Come, taste death.
My claws speak truth.

lines.zh: 我原地不动，只等你走进视线。
lines.en: I don't move. I wait till you're in sight.
Your life is no match for my claws.

lines.zh: 爪子原地挥出，照样见血。
lines.en: The claw swings without a step and still draws blood.
It needn't chase; you're right there.
One claw tears this scene open.

lines.zh: 它的牙齿是道具，也是真的。
lines.en: Its teeth are props, and also real.
Standing still, it can still bite you.
Prey in sight!
Waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 我从门框的影子里被摆出来。
lines.en: I'm set down out of the doorway's shadow.
Patience, and the prey will come.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的爪子从未缺席！
lines.en: In the dark, my claws always strike.
Your prey is before you.

lines.zh: 剧本翻到这一页，我正看着你。
lines.en: The script turns to this page, and I'm watching.

lines.zh: 我一步都不动，等你靠近。
lines.en: I won't move a step; come closer.
Prey is about to fall.
Prey is close at hand.
It has been placed in this corner.
Act two begins; the hunter is in position.
A figure condenses out of the air.

lines.zh: 剧情推进，它出现在门口。
lines.en: The plot advances, and it appears in the doorway.

lines.zh: 它没有走来，它本来就在。
lines.en: It did not walk here; it was always here.
The story nails it in front of you.

lines.zh: 黑暗里多了一个站立的身影。
lines.en: A standing figure joins the dark.
It opens its eyes, and the play begins.

lines.zh: 你听见脚本翻到了这一页。
lines.en: You hear the script turn to this page.
The hunter is called up out of the shadow.

Injured from fall, wails endlessly
Injured from drowning, groans in pain
Injured by explosion, wails repeatedly

Injured by magic, mourns in pain
